MAKE IT YOURS

Edit the musical anchors

Beat 0 is the start. One beat = one quarter note. Middle C = C4 = MIDI 60.
#Pitch / octaveStart beatDurationStart (s)Remove
Import or edit note-event JSON

Paste a full project, or an array of {pitch, start, duration} events. Pitch accepts a MIDI number or a note such as F#4. Times are in quarter-note beats.

The app and first study live in the cloud repo. Edits save on this device; exported JSON and shared links carry your notes to other devices. Shared links contain the project data. There is no automatic cloud sync.

FROM REFERENCE TO DRAWING

A steady hand, a light touch.

01

Set the musical paper

For this study: A · Major · 1 octave · Octave +1 · 88 BPM · 1/8 · Swing Off. Use a wide desktop window. The complete canvas is 16 beats, not 9; the melody ends at 56.25% of its width.

02

Draw the notes separately

Use Skeleton + full-canvas layout. For each short eighth note, tap near the center of its half-beat cell. For a longer note, draw horizontally through its cells. Lift your pen between notes, even when the pitch repeats.

03

Let the image carry the art

The dashed contour and amber ribbon belong in the reference image. Drawing them as ink can add or change notes. A background photo is silent. Leave the shaded rest area empty.

The second bar holds D4 for three beats. The site’s synthetic keys decay differently from an acoustic piano. Export MIDI and compare it with the event table before calling the result verified.
